negative_findings.description: No Hungarian event branded 'Budapest Banking Summit' was found. English seed-query searching returned only unrelated Budapest summits (Demographic Summit, Solarplaza, CEE Summit) and MNB's Renminbi Initiative conference.
negative_findings.result_summary: The banking-summit role in Hungary is filled by Portfolio's conference series and FinTechZone's TechShow family, not by an event of that name.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents wasted verification effort and mis-scoped collectors; the seed query term should be retired in favour of the real event brands.

negative_findings.description: The Év Bankja site exposes jury pages under year-specific URLs, but only older editions (2015, 2016) surfaced in search; the current-edition jury roster was not located, and press coverage described the jury only as an 'független szakmai zsűri' without naming members.
negative_findings.result_summary: Historical jury registries are retrievable; the current-year jury list is unconfirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The jury is a titleholder registry of adjacent industry figures; if the current list is not published, longitudinal jury tracking degrades to a lagging indicator.

negative_findings.description: The Magyar Bankszövetség does not appear to run its own public flagship conference with a published speaker programme; searches in Hungarian returned Portfolio events where the association speaks, not an association-hosted agenda.
negative_findings.result_summary: Association leadership appears on third-party stages rather than its own.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection for association officeholders must go through Portfolio agendas plus the association press room, not a conference page.

negative_findings.description: No established Hungarian-language term was found for 'speaker roster / titleholder registry' as an intelligence artefact; the only local handles are the page labels 'Előadók', 'Program' and 'Zsűri'.
negative_findings.result_summary: Hungarian discovery must rely on page-label terms plus job-title nouns (igazgató, vezető, vezérigazgató-helyettes, divízióvezető, ügyvezető igazgató).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query design for this cell should target title nouns and page labels, not concept words, or recall collapses.

negative_findings.description: Speaker announcements on X/Twitter (MNB and organiser accounts) are behind a login wall and covered by anti-scraping ToS.
negative_findings.result_summary: Social-first announcements cannot be collected automatically.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The earliest signal of a speaker/title change is partly unavailable; official websites must be polled more frequently to compensate.

coverage_gaps.description: Past-edition speaker pages are the core value of this cell (title drift between editions), but several organisers rewrite or retire event URLs; no snapshot layer is in place.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair every roster crawl with a Wayback Machine snapshot lookup and store our own dated HTML copies so title-drift diffs survive site rewrites.

coverage_gaps.description: Current-year jury and speaker rosters for Év Bankja and for TechShow X 2026 were not directly confirmed page-by-page in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Targeted fetch of evbankja.hu jury/current-edition paths and the TechShow X speaker page once the 2026 agenda is published (Jun–Oct 2026).

coverage_gaps.description: Insurance-adjacent and savings-cooperative/neobank events, and vendor-hosted client days (core-banking and card-processing suppliers), were not enumerated; these carry mid-level operations and IT titles.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a discovery sweep over vendor client-day and insurance conference agendas, filtering speakers by financial-institution employer.

coverage_gaps.description: Hungarian job titles vary in wording across organisers for the same role, and English event pages give different renderings; no normalisation dictionary exists yet.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a hu→en title normalisation table (vezérigazgató, vezérigazgató-helyettes, ügyvezető igazgató, divízióvezető, igazgatóságvezető, területi igazgató, szakmai vezető) so title drift is measured on normalised roles, not raw strings.

coverage_gaps.description: Only the Mastercard Év Bankja programme was mapped; other Hungarian financial awards and shortlists (marketing, IT, employer-brand, insurance awards) that also publish juries and named entrants were not covered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up sweep on 'díj', 'pályázat', 'zsűri', 'shortlist' plus finance keywords to enumerate secondary award registries.

brief: Hungary's banking/payments event layer is concentrated in three publishers whose pages function as continuously refreshed titleholder registries: Portfolio.hu's conference series (Hitelezés, Financial IT, Banking Technology) with per-event /eloadok pages, FinTechZone's FinTechShow/BankTechShow/PayTechShow family (merging into TechShow X on 14-15 Oct 2026), and the MNB's own conference tree led by the Lámfalussy Lectures, which uniquely maintains a multi-year 'previous speakers' archive. On the awards side, the Mastercard – Év Bankja programme (20th edition, 9 categories, 13 competing institutions) publishes year-stamped jury pages under stable URL patterns plus winner coverage that names the executives who collected each prize. Specialist and adjacent events extend reach into layers no directory covers — Financial Fraud Summit and the businessevents.hu/IIR bank verticals expose bank security, AML and fraud-prevention unit heads, while e-commerce, AI and marketing conferences surface card-scheme and acquirer commercial roles. The binding constraints are not discovery but preservation and normalisation: past-edition pages get rewritten, current-year jury lists are often unpublished, and the same role appears under several Hungarian title strings, so snapshotting and a hu→en title dictionary should precede any drift-detection logic.
